item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 18/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense winter monsoon will bring cold weather to Guangdong persistently in the next couple of days. It will be windy, fine and very dry over the region. Daytime temperatures over the coast of southern China are expected to rise slightly in the middle and latter parts of this week. However, under the influence of replenishments of the monsoon, it will still be rather cool in the morning and at night.

Date/Month: 19/12 (Monday)
Wind: Northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Cold. Fine and very dry.
Temp range: 9 - 15 C
R.H. range: 35 - 60 per Cent
PSR: Low
